SPIRE1-DEMON_REAPER_STANCE_POWER.title: Demon and Reaper Forms
SPIRE1-DEMON_REAPER_STANCE_POWER.descrip: Replaces Wrath without its original double damage. Let n be the current combat round, starting at 1. Demon: on entry and at the start of each of your turns, increase this form's Strength contribution toward n*(n+1)/2; remove only its contribution on exit. Each damage instance dealt to you by an enemy deals n additional damage, not self or allied damage. Reaper: your or your pet's powered attack damage applies Doom equal to that hit's total damage, including the blocked portion. Each hit is counted separately.

SPIRE1-ECHO_CELESTIAL_STANCE_POWER.title: Echo and Celestial Forms
SPIRE1-ECHO_CELESTIAL_STANCE_POWER.descr: Replaces Divinity without its original triple damage or extra 3 Energy. Echo: the next card played after entry is played one additional time, once per entry; other repeats are preserved. The entering play neither receives nor consumes this Echo. Celestial: immediately gain max(n, 3) Energy and draw that many cards, where n is the current combat round. Leave Divinity at the start of your next turn, not at this turn's end. Entering during turn-start hooks does not cause an immediate exit.
